title: GEAR$^2$: Pruned Experts Live On through Gated Reuse of Activated Experts and a Missing-Mass Residual
abstract: arXiv:2611.20616v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Large Language Models (LLMs) activate only a few experts per token while generally keeping all the experts in GPU memory for high efficiency. Expert pruning reduces this GPU memory footprint cost, yet discards the contribution of pruned experts. Existing remedies either rely on static substitutes, merge experts at the cost of altering their functions, or require costly recovery training. In this paper, we find that the functionalities of pruned experts can be efficiently reconstructed from the activated remaining experts. We propose GEAR (Gated Expert Activation Reuse), which reuses the scaled outputs of reliable activated experts without any training or additional expert computation. In addition, we propose GEAR$^2$ to further recover what reuse cannot express with an ultra-lightweight residual. translated_title: GEAR²：被剪枝专家通过门控复用已激活专家与缺失质量残差得以延续
translated_abstract: 混合专家大语言模型每个 token 仅激活少数专家，但通常会将所有专家保留在 GPU 内存中以维持高效率。专家剪枝可以降低这种 GPU 内存占用成本，却会丢弃被剪枝专家的贡献。现有的补救方法要么依赖静态替代品，要么以改变专家功能为代价合并专家，要么需要昂贵的恢复训练。在本文中，我们发现被剪枝专家的功能可以从已激活的剩余专家中高效重构。我们提出了 GEAR（门控专家激活复用），它无需任何训练或额外的专家计算，即可复用可靠的已激活专家的缩放输出。此外，我们提出 GEAR²，通过一个超轻量级的残差进一步恢复复用所无法表达的部分。在五个参数量从 16B 到 106B 的 MoE 大语言模型上，分别剪枝 25% 和 50% 的专家后，GEAR 相对于其免训练（基线）取得了提升……
tldr: 提出GEAR²方法，无需任何训练，通过门控复用已激活专家的缩放输出并辅以超轻量级残差，即可高效重构被剪枝MoE专家的功能，在大幅降低GPU内存占用的同时保持模型性能。
en_tdlr: GEAR² training-free-ly reconstructs the functionality of pruned MoE experts by gated reuse of scaled outputs from activated experts plus an ultra-lightweight missing-mass residual, slashing GPU memory footprint while preserving performance.
